posts.title: Apple Unveils iPhone 18 Pro & First Foldable iPhone Duo
posts.subtitle: Surprise and Shine event — live from Cupertino

slides.text:
SURPRISE AND SHINE
Apple unveils iPhone 18 Pro & iPhone Duo
Meet iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max & the first foldable iPhone Duo

iPhone 18 Pro from $1,199 — Pro Max $1,299 — Duo $1,999
Deep black • Refined silver • Glacier blue • Burgundy
Pro preorders Sep 12 → available Sep 18
Duo preorders Oct 16 → available Oct 23
A20 2nm • 12GB RAM • 48MP triple camera

iPhone Duo is book-style foldable — first ever iPhone folding
Apple's first event under CEO John Ternus
AirPods 5 $129 / $149 wireless • Watch Series 12 & Ultra 4 also unveiled
All available Sep 18 (Duo Oct 23)
